messages:
devon: Quick thread: need rules for quota-triggered auto-fallbacks after a retry burst caused a flip.

nina: Product: quota alone should only start a probe. Promote to full fallback only with error/latency corroboration or sustained breach.

sam: Runtime plan: emit `probe_event` and `fallback_event`. Probe includes probe_id, sample_rate, bucket_counts. Full fallback logs policy_snapshot.

charlie: SRE: enforce hysteresis. Proposal: require 3 consecutive 15s buckets over threshold OR 60s sustained breach. Cooldown 30s. Operator override allowed but timeboxed.

maria: UX: show chip "probe (quota)" with sparkline. Drawer shows probe_id, sample coverage, sampled traces, and a "promote" CTA with confirmation and policy snapshot.

devon: Retention proposal: full traces 14d, probe metadata and policy snapshots 180d, with on-demand export for legal holds.

sam: Audit blob (single-line JSON) fields: id, type, trigger, route, sample_rate, consecutive_buckets, policy_version, operator_action. Emit to logs and add metric label fallback_reason.

nina: Product requires immutable operator action entries and a replay token to reproduce the exact environment in the simulator.

charlie: Edge-case: add min_requests_per_window (default 50) so small tenants don't trigger quota probes. Make it tenant-configurable.

devon: Actions: @sam add probe/fallback telemetry + min_volume guard; @charlie write cost/retention estimate; @maria mock chip + drawer; @nina spec operator-audit schema and replay token. I'll schedule a 30m sync.

opsbot: ci/rollouts/canary ✅ canary healthy on 2 routes.
